text:
matt: Heads-up — cutover Thurs 09:00 PST. Freeze window starts 08:30. Plan: bump to v1.12.0, changelog push, smoke canary + rollback verified. Any blockers?

jess: Security review in flight, should have a quick signoff by EOD. Found one transitive dep to re-scan. pinging @matt for dependency note. :mag_right:

kumar: QA: running full regression on staging now. Saw flaky test in realtime-client; isolating. Will run a dedicated smoke sweep at 20:00 PST tonight.

lia: Docs: changelog draft at PR #614, migration notes added for config toggle. Waiting on one small wording pass. @matt can you confirm the short blurb for the release notes?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled window created: 2026-03-19 08:30-10:00 PST. Canary policy: 10% for 10m then 50% for 20m. Auto-fallback enabled.

jess: quick update on the dep — patch is in branch `deps/patch-2026` and will be merged after smoke. No exploitable issue, low severity.

matt: Rollback runbook (short):
```
1) Pause traffic via load-balancer -> maintenance route
2) Revert git tag to v1.11.3
3) Redeploy previous image: registry.redwood/internal:v1.11.3
4) Validate core health endpoints and consumer-facing flows
5) Notify channels + update incident log
```
@kumar please exercise steps 1-3 on staging today and report timing.

kumar: Will do. ETA for staging rollback smoke: 15:00 PST. I'll post results here.

tina: SRE: I'll be the on-call owner during cutover. Will monitor canary metrics and be ready to flip fallback. Recommend we keep DB migrations reversible; none scheduled, right?

matt: No DB migrations in this release — safe. Good call.

lia: Docs updated with rollback snippet and example toggles. Also added a short troubleshooting FAQ.

jess: :white_check_mark: security pro-tem signoff (pending final quick re-scan at 15:30)

kumar: :white_check_mark: QA smoke passed locally, will confirm staging rollback at 15:30 and update

tina: :white_check_mark: SRE ready for canary/fallback ops

matt: Final ask: please add your :white_check_mark: once you verify staging and PRs merged. I'll enforce branch freeze at 07:30 PST on cutover day and kick the cutover at 09:00. If anyone needs an exception, flag now.

deploy-bot: canary started at 09:02 PST — initial latency and error rate within SLOs. (bot auto-message after deployment)
